description: Controlled list of stone types for Umiña metadata (umina-achala-chain#14). properties.stone_type and properties.materials[].stone_type must be an id from this list. Ids are permanent: never rename or delete one; mark a wrong entry deprecated with replaced_by instead. kind is mineral, variety, rock, trade_name, metal or fossil; fossils are listed only so they are refused with a clear message (Ley 31204). ima_species is the IMA mineral species, where there is one. hs_code is the default HS code. Curated entries were seeded from umina-achala-documents/umina_specimens_hs_codes.md; entries with source "ima" are the IMA-approved species imported by src/mint/importIma.js (see ima_import): English name only (name.es is absent, the site falls back to English) and no default HS code.

ima_import.source: RRUFF IMA Mineral List (rruff.net), IMA approved minerals only
